newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's IGP-M index rises 0.06 pct Apr 21-May 10.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's IGP-M index rises 0.06 pct Apr 21-May 10.

text.p: Brazilian IGP-M inflation index rose 0.06 percent between April 21 and May 10, compared with a 0.54 percent rise between March 21 and April 10, the Getulio Vargas Foudation (FGV) said on Tuesday.

The IGP-M is composed of three economic indicators: the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.01 percent in the period; the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 0.07 percent; and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.29 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
